notes:
Quick summary: CedarBridge is a mid-enterprise CCaaS provider powering ~650 customer contact centers. Primary KPI: agent suggestion latency + availability during seasonal spikes. They run a mix of voice->ASR->NLU->agent UI; want LLM-based assist and automated ticketing (tool-calling into Zendesk/Salesforce).

Highlights from discovery:
- "If AI slows during Black Friday it's a non-starter" — CTO on call.
- They care about graceful degradation: prefer deterministic fallbacks (smaller model / cached response) rather than request rejection.
- Want dedicated warm pools for predictable 99.9% avail during 2x-5x spikes.
- Interested in function/tool-calling to auto-fill ticket fields and trigger downstream workflows.
- Data residency: US-only for certain enterprise customers.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; will accept higher baseline for guaranteed SLAs but want clear burst pricing and visibility.

Conversation quirks and notes: shorthand, lots of "we need" bullets in the doc. SE asked for capacity curves + sample traffic traces (sent). Security team requested SOC2 + KMS integration details.

Internal AE notes: POC targets = 90 days, start with a 500-agent pilot (staggered), expand to full 5k-agent burst sim. Keep messaging targeted to reliability + predictable economics.

latency_targets: agent suggestion latency <150ms 95th% under typical load; graceful degrade to <500ms during sustained 2x spikes
throughput_targets: sustain 5k concurrent suggestion requests during peak 10:00-12:00 events; burst to 20k for <1hr windows (Black Friday style)
notes_short: Spike reliability focus. Wants warm pools, fallback models, and clear burst pricing. Security + residency gating POC start.
demo_notes: Requested demo of warm-pool behavior under synthetic spike, show KV/prefix caching impact, and example tool-calls into Zendesk (auto-update tickets).
deal_risks: Legal wants explicit data residency addendum; finance wants fixed-cost cap on Black Friday-esque bursts; integration complexity with legacy ASR pipeline.
win_criteria: POC demonstrates <150ms suggestion latency at 95th% for baseline and graceful degrade plan validated during 2x and 5x synthetic spikes; SOC2/KMS sign-off; agreed SOW for dedicated warm-pool sizing
remarks: Good fit for Redwood Dedicated + Optimize. Likely upsell path to Private if residency + strict control demanded later. SE to finalize perf-runbook before SOW sign-off.
